run_vrp_training: run the VRP model training loop with configurable epochs, batch size, and learning rate decay
run_vrp_evaluation: run the VRP model evaluation on a test dataset and print loss and reward metrics
create_vrp_model: create a VRP model instance with optional pretrained weights or fresh parameter initialization
resume_vrp_training: resume VRP model training from a saved checkpoint at a specified iteration number
load_vrp_dataset: load VRP training or evaluation dataset using the vrpDataProcessor utility
